as_told.title: Ruppelt: sightings clustered at atomic weapons sites

plain: In 1952, the Air Force's chief UFO investigator, Captain Edward J. Ruppelt, was quoted saying that "many of the sightings reported had originated at one atomic weapons related site or another all around the country." The quote comes from a 1952 Look magazine article called "The Hunt for the Flying Saucer," which Michels reads out in two episodes, one of them about UFOs and nuclear bases. It matters because it would mean the Air Force's own investigator saw a link between sightings and nuclear weapons sites as early as 1952.
